name: go-nest
description: gots — a TypeScript-syntax language transpiling to exact-semantics Go — plus nestgo, a NestJS-style framework + app written in it

scripts.build: node gots/src/cli.ts build nestgo/src && go -C nestgo build ./...
scripts.dev: node gots/src/cli.ts build nestgo/src && go -C nestgo run ./src/
scripts.examples: node gots/src/cli.ts build gots/examples/hello.ts && node gots/src/cli.ts build gots/examples/concurrency.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run examples && npm run build
